info.title: ATIMS Laravel API Documentation
info.description: This is the auto-generated Swagger API documentation for ATIMS.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of assets with optional search and filtering

post.description: Creates a new asset with full metadata. Spatial POINT is auto-generated from GPS coordinates.

get.description: Returns a specific asset by its ID with full details

put.description: Updates an existing asset. Records change in audit ledger.

delete.description: Soft deletes an asset (does not remove from database - anti-corruption requirement)

post.description: Search assets by state_id, name, or description

get.description: Get summary statistics for all assets
Get all attachments for the authenticated user or a specific asset

post.description: Upload a file attachment for an asset, inspection, or ledger entry

400.description: File type or size validation error

post.summary: Login user and return authentication token
post.description: Authenticate user with username and password, returns JWT token

get.description: Get all assets with status for map rendering
Get assets that haven't been inspected in the last 90 days
Returns the health status of the API including database connection

post.description: Log an incident by scanning a QR code. Updates asset status to "En Panne".
Verify a repair by rescanning the asset. Performs Haversine distance check.

get.description: Get all unresolved incidents (assets in "En Panne" status)
Get all inspection and ledger history for an asset

post.description: Create an inspection for an asset with GPS telemetry. Blocks if GPS accuracy > 15m.

400.description: GPS accuracy too low or validation error

get.description: Returns a specific inspection with full details
Scan a QR code for field agents. Requires authentication.
Verify a QR code for public verification. No authentication required.

post.description: Assign an incident to a Field Agent for resolution

get.description: Get tasks assigned to the current user or global queue
Get all unassigned tasks in the global queue

put.description: Update task status (e.g., mark as completed)

post.description: Allow a field agent to self-assign a task from the global queue

404.description: Task not found or not in global queue

get.description: Dummy Endpoint to satisfy Swagger's requirement for at least one route.
